text:
Source-assisted reading of F-xoto (Stams, Frg. 218), made with the 1603 Glossa/Lyra print in hand. Reread on the images: canvas 1, left leaf, col. b, lines 1-10; canvas 1, right leaf, col. a, lines 1-11; canvas 0, right leaf, col. a, middle, 10 lines; canvas 1, right leaf, col. b, about 25 lines (read first without the source, then rechecked against the image). Expansions in parentheses; (?) uncertain; [ ] lost or supplied; *...* red-underlined lemma. Native-pixel boxes are x0,y0,x1,y1.

Canvas 1 (Stams_STA_Frg_218_01v), left leaf, col. b, box 2560,950,3880,1720:
1 [Di]cebat aut(em) [lemma]. Postq(ua)m  [red rubric] Cap. xviii.
2 [D initial] salvator ostendit q(uod) peccatores penitentes s(un)t benig(n)e
3 recipiendi (et) caute nutriendi. H(ic) co(n)s(equente)r ostendit q(uod) s(un)t
4 in devoc(i)o(n)e nutriendi (et) di(viditur) in duas quia p(rim)o devoc(i)o(n)em(?) describit
5 (et) instructio(nem)(?). S(ecund)o instructio(n)is co(n)firmac(i)o(nem) i(bi) *Factu(m) e(st) aut(em)*. Circa p(ri)mu(m)
6 sciend(um) q(uod) devoc(i)o potissime co(n)sistit in or(ati)o(n)e q(ue) e(st) ascens(us) mentis
7 in deu(m) s(ecundu)m Damasc(enum). D(icit) (er)go q(uod) salvator h(ic) instruit p(rese)ntes discip(u)los
8 qui iam erant ad eu(m) co(n)versi (et) co(n)s(equente)r futuros ad eu(m) p(er) p(eniten)ciam(?) co(n)-
9 vertendi. P(ri)mo (er)go ostendit or(ati)o(n)is efficacia(m). S(ecund)o inducit discip(u)los
10 ad m(ar)tirii tollerancia(m) i(bi) *Assumpsit aut(em)* (et) p(atet) ordo quia ...

7 du(m) co(n)ceptu(m) rei p(er)fectu(m) (et) d(e)t(er)minatu(m) qui a ph(ilosoph)is vocatur
8 diffinic(i)o, a s(an)c(t)is aut(em) d(icitu)r p(ro)p(ri)e v(er)bu(m) (et) h(oc) e(st) q(uod) d(icit) Aug(ustinus) ix de
9 Trinitate diffinic(i)o te(m)p(er)a(n)cie [corrected in the line] (et) h(oc) e(st) v(er)bu(m) ei(us) (et) sic p(atet) p(ri)-

(et) s(ecundu)m r(ati)o(n)em similitudi(n)is quia de r(ati)o(n)e v(er)bi e(st) q(uod) sit [...] similitudo illi(us) cui(us) e(st) v(er)bu(m)
... sunt p(er) o(mne)m mo(dum) p(ro)pt(er) q(uod) d(icit) Aug(ustinus) vi de trinitate V(er)bu(m) so[lus] filius accipit(ur) (et) eo d(icitu)r v(er)bu(m) quo filius.
His p(re)li[batis] accedend(um)(?) e(st) ad declarac(i)o(n)em p(ri)me co(n)clusio(n)is q(ua)m i(n)du[cit] iohannes ad p(ro)band(um) et(er)na(m) filii g(e)n(er)ac(i)o(n)em
... (et) id(eo) n(on) p(otes)t paucis v(er)b(is) (et) modicu(m) declarari. In r(ati)o(n)e a[utem] ista b(eatu)s Johannes supponit unu(m) q(uod) ab o(mn)ib(us) supponit(ur) ta(m)q(uam) manifestu(m) s(cilicet) q(uod) d(eu)s sit p(ri)ncipiu(m) simpl(iciter) p(ri)mu(m)
... in q(uan)tu(m) e(st) in actu p(er)fecto ...
cu(m) (er)go v(er)bu(m) (et) filius idem sint seq(ui)t(ur) q(uod) ibi sit g(e)n(er)ac(i)[o] filii a p(at)re ...
b(eatu)s Johannes ponit t(antu)m co(n)clusio(n)em obmittens [...] deducc(i)o(n)em sic(ut) freq(ue)nt(er) faciunt ph(ilosoph)i tangentes solu(m) una(m) p(ro)po(siti)o(n)e(m) sue r(ati)o(n)is. (et) h(oc) mo(do) dic(it) Johannes *In p[rincipio] erat v(er)bu(m)* i(d est) in ip(s)o deo qui ab o(mn)ib(us) suppo(nitur) p(ri)m(um)

Canvas 0 (Stams_STA_Frg_218_01r), right leaf, col. a, box 4080,1980,5150,2680:
1 [...] *huic arbori moro* i(d est) d(icere) poteritis *eradi-*
2 *care (et) t(ra)nsplantare i(n) mare*. Duo mira co(n)iungit s(cilicet) eradicac(i)o(n)em
3 subita(m) arboris de t(er)ra solida (et) t(ra)nsplantac(i)o(n)em eius in aqua
4 fluida ut pl(us)(?) mag(is) appareat v(ir)t(us) fidei. Et q(ui)a de talib(us) op(er)i-
5 b(us) q(ue) n(on)(?) fiunt v(ir)tute credentis s(ed) v(ir)tute dei op(er)antis nullu(s)
6 debet elevari s(ed) mag(is) s(ub) deo humiliari id(eo) subd(it) *Quis aut(em) v(est)r(u)m*
7 *h(abe)ns s(er)vu(m) arantem* i(d est) laborante(m) in agro *qui regresso* s(cilicet) de
8 labore *dicat illi statim transi (et) recumbe* i(d est) quiesce p(ost) labore(m) (et)
9 refocillare q(uasi) d(icat) Non ... d(icit) ei *Para*
10 *quod cenem* ... p(ost) labore(m) in agro requirit(ur) ab eo labor i(n) domo.
